title: Staleness planner/auditor: frontmatter model, descricoes Step 7/8, Spec Sourcing morto
description: Bundle de staleness nos prompts de plan (auditoria 2026-07-08): (1) subagent-planner.md:4 frontmatter hardcoda model: claude-opus-4-8 mas project.toml:11 define planner = claude-fable-5 e o runtime usa readPhaseModel -> --model claude-fable-5 (plan-argv.ts:83) que sobrepoe o frontmatter; alinhar ou remover o campo. (2) descriptions de planner e auditor dizem Invoked from /cam-plan Step 7/8; real: cam-plan.md virou signal-writer sem steps e quem spawna e o runPlanPhase deterministico (plan-runner.ts:705/718, ADR-0006); reescrever pra spawned by the deterministic plan runner. (3) secao Spec Sourcing do planner (:76-81) referencia campos specSource/Spec/derivedFrom no Task prompt que os builders reais (buildPlannerTaskPrompt plan-runner.ts:67-73, buildReplanPlannerTaskPrompt :96-112) NUNCA passam; guidance morta, deletar ou trocar por leia o issue file. (4) cam-plan.md:11 descreve selecao como rank asc then id asc; real: selectPlannableIssue e champion-vs-champion (min-rank ranked vs max-WSJF unranked, select.ts:64-89); corrigir descricao. Origem: auditoria planner/auditor 2026-07-08.
